segments.name: Integrated Auto Sales and Finance
segments.description: Sells older model used vehicles and provides financing for customers with limited financial resources and imperfect credit histories, primarily in small South-Central U.S. cities.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single reportable segment which represents our core business of offering integrated automotive sales and financing solutions for customers with limited financial resources regardless of credit history.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for used vehicles and make principal and interest payments on installment sales contracts the Company originates and services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company provides financing in connection with the sale of substantially all of its vehicles.
